question: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam** is associated with the** Kuchipudi dance** form.
 
• He is a **renowned choreographer **and performer of Kuchipudi dance.
 
• He was born in Kuchipudi village in** Andhra Pradesh** and started learning dance from his father.
 
• He established the **Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai **to promote and teach Kuchipudi dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak **is a classical dance form from **North India**, known for its intricate footwork and storytelling.

 
 
• It originated in the **Mughal courts** and was popularized by the famous dancer **Birju Maharaj.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form from **Manipur,** known for its graceful movements and religious themes.
 
 
• It has its roots in the **Vaishnavite tradition** and is performed in temples and festivals.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam **is a classical dance form from **Tamil Nadu,** known for its expressive gestures and rhythmic footwork.
 
 
• It has a rich history and has evolved over centuries, with many **famous dancers and gurus **contributing to its development.
